wacc.formula: WACC = wₑ × kₑ + w_d × k_d × (1 − t);  kₑ = r_f + β × ERP
steps: β (Blume-adjusted) = 0.67 × raw β — + 0.33 = 1.00  (fewer than 52 weeks of prices: beta 1.0 assumed)
k_d = 6.58%  (5-year Treasury 4.91% + model spread 167 bp (bond-calibrated, app/debt.py)); after tax 6.58% × (1 − 21%) = 5.20%

methods.method: Sum of the parts (segments × peer EV/Sales)
methods.formula: Value = (Σ segment revenue × its peer EV/Sales − net debt) ÷ shares
steps: Commercial insurance and managed care (excluding Medicare and Medicaid managed care): $3.13B (latest quarter × 4) × 1.4x = $4.25B
assumptions: median EV/Sales of the industry each segment name maps to
methods.fit: It reports 6 revenue segments, which can deserve different multiples.

methods.method: Sum of the parts, weighted (segments × weighted peer EV/Sales)
methods.formula: Value = (Σ segment revenue × its peers' weighted EV/Sales − net debt) ÷ shares
steps: Commercial insurance and managed care (excluding Medicare and Medicaid managed care): $3.13B × 1.5x (plain 1.4x; 12.6 effective peers) = $4.83B
inputs: Complementary Revenue: EXPE 20%, BKNG 20%, XPO 20%; Commercial insurance and managed care (excluding Medicare and Medicaid managed care): BRK-B 20%, PGR 10%, CB 9%; Medicare: EXPE 20%, BKNG 20%, XPO 20%; Other third-party payors: EXPE 20%, BKNG 20%, XPO 20%; Medicaid: EXPE 20%, BKNG 20%, XPO 20%; Self-pay: EXPE 20%, BKNG 20%, XPO 20%
market value, revenue and trading value shares
assumptions: geometric mean of the peer's shares of market value, revenue and trading value
an assumption: the largest peer weighs most but is never the whole answer
an assumption: last year's quarters count half
median daily close × volume, last 63 sessions
methods.fit: It reports 6 revenue segments, which can deserve different multiples. Weighting the peers by market value, revenue and trading value, and their quarters by recency, keeps small, thinly traded peers and old prices from moving the multiple as much.

methods.formula: Value per share = (equity − goodwill − intangibles) ÷ shares, floored at 0; low end × 0.8
assumptions: an assumption (XBRL frames carry no asset-level haircuts)

methods.formula: Net cash per share = (cash − debt − other claims) ÷ diluted shares, floored at 0
steps: Market-implied value of the pipeline (EV) = market value − net cash = $772.2M − −$3.93B = $4.70B
inputs: SEC XBRL frames: diluted weighted-average shares
assumptions: a floor: no filing prices a drug trial or an unlaunched product
methods.fit: It is pre-revenue (— of revenue over four quarters, with an operating loss): its cash is the one solid number, and the rest of the price is a bet on its pipeline.

methods.formula: Stage-weighted value = Σ weight × central value of the stage's methods (weights renormalized over the methods available)
assumptions: fixed by stage before any result was seen (base_rates.STAGES)
methods.fit: Its stage is “Pre-revenue” — revenue not reported over four quarters, operating income ≤ 0 — which fixes these methods and their weights in advance.
